$comment: Hand-written automation merged over spells-5.1.json (2014) and spells-5.2.json (2024) at load. Each spell id maps to fields for both editions and/or for one edition.

both.gmNote: On a miss it still takes half the first damage. A higher slot adds 1d4 to the later damage too.

both.gmNote: You know the shortest, most direct way to the place.
